register.labelZh: PAL AND PALM 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: PAL AND PALM Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: pal up 可以描述人們在學校、大學、工作場所或活動中認識後,逐漸成為朋友。；palm somebody off 可以表示某人沒有得到真正幫助,反而只得到不實答覆、薄弱藉口或令人不滿意的東西。；palm something off on somebody 可以表示某人把自己不想要的人、東西或工作推給另一個人。；palm something off as something 可以描述仿製品、廉價商品或普通物件被冒充為真品或貴價物品。
register.summaryEn: Pal up describes people becoming friendly, especially after meeting at school, college, work or an event. Palm somebody off can show that someone receives an untrue answer, a weak excuse or something unsatisfactory instead of real help. Palm something off on somebody shows that someone makes another person accept something that they do not want. Palm something off as something helps you describe copies, cheap products or ordinary objects being presented as genuine or valuable.
